message: View "ActiveUsers" is not supported; Prisma 8 has no views. Remove the view or replace it with a model over the underlying table.

Field "User.balance": native type "@db.Money" has no Prisma 8 codec yet, and Prisma 8 cannot read this schema until it supports the column type. @ignore on the field or @@ignore on the model does not help: Prisma 8 keeps the columns of ignored fields and models in the contract. Changing the field's type to one Prisma 8 supports changes the column type on Prisma 7's next migration.
